bias.en: Bearish · rebound back above the 5-day, capped near $296
bias.zh: 看空 · 反弹重回 5 日均线上方，受阻于 $296 附近

read.en: Alphabet rose 3.2% on Nov 4 to $288.93, trading between $283.51 and $296.49 on heavy volume. It is above the falling 5-day ($282.3) and below the falling 10-day ($301.8), 30-day ($330.7), 100-day ($343.3) and 200-day ($340.0) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 16 ($309.06), and RSI is 30.
read.zh: Alphabet 11月4日上涨 3.2%，收于 $288.93，盘中区间 $283.51–296.49，成交量放大。股价位于下行的 5 日均线（$282.3）上方，并低于下行的 10 日（$301.8）、30 日（$330.7）、100 日（$343.3）和 200 日均线（$340.0）。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月16日起看空（$309.06），RSI 为 30。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $281.6–288.3 resistance (Oct 29–Nov 3 highs), now support; the $296.49 high reached the $294.1–296.3 zone and faded. Resistance is $294.1–296.5 (Mar 9 and Feb 17 lows, Nov 4 high), then $301.8 (10-day) and $309.1 (SAR). Support is $281.6–283.5, then $276.9–277.2 and $270.7–272.1. A close above $296.5 would target $302–309; below $281.6, $277.

r.en: Mar 9 low $294.1; Feb 17 low $296.3; Nov 4 high $296.5

s.en: 5-day average $282.3; Nov 3 high $281.6 and Oct 30 high $283.1, reclaimed; Nov 4 low $283.5
